model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of various biomedical entity types. The chart is divided into 20 slices, each representing a different category. These categories include "Chemical" (blue, approximately 37%), "Protein" (light blue, approximately 25%), "DNA" (green, approximately 6%), "Chemical Family" (purple, approximately 9%), "Cell" (yellow, approximately 5%), "Drug" (orange, approximately 3%), "Disease" (red, approximately 3%), and several smaller categories such as "Gene or Gene Product" (brown, approximately 2%), "Specific Disease" (pink, approximately 2%), and "Sequence Variant" (magenta, approximately 2%). A legend is provided to identify each category with its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and some slices, like "Chemical" and "Protein," appear slightly offset from the center. The segments appear ordered visually in descending order by approximate percentage size.
